caption:
Standing on a vibration plate is not a workout on its own; the benefit comes from squats, lunges and balance work on it. Beginners need a gentle first level. Claude settles on the LifePro Waver, GPT on the Power Plate my3. Who should ask a doctor first: 1billionmodels.com/vibration-platform-machines

Two AI models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol) chose with no web access; nobody tested these products. Synthetic voice. AI-made video.
title: Oscillating or vertical vibration plate? Check this first
